idle.note: two rigid groups breathe in turn: the head end (head, ring 1, ring 2) rises 1 px with the maw tipping up 3 degrees, then the tail end (ring 6, tail) rises 1 px; the middle rings stay still; the front legs twitch once each. Not a travelling wave.

move.note: inchworm crawl: the rings bunch and stretch in a wave from tail to head (rigid rings translating 2-3 px) while the six legs scurry in alternating sets

gnaw.note: rears the maw up and back, then snaps it forward and down onto the target at contact; the first two rings follow, the rest brace

burrow.note: rears its maw up, then dives head-first: the head tips down and pushes into the floor and each ring follows in turn, sinking 10 px while the whole grub fades out; the board then shows the burrow mound

erupt.note: bursts up out of the floor maw-first at the marked tile (fades in over 0.12), rears to full height, snaps the maw down at contact, then settles

hit.note: knocked back in a quick 2 px wave from head to tail; the maw flinches up; the legs flail

death.note: curls up: the head and tail lift toward each other, the middle rings sag 2 px, the legs curl in; terminal pose held
